scope: P2-L2 research-only training and pre-holdout validation

split.method: chronological fixed UTC boundaries with complete label-interval and event-group purge
split.boundary_selection: signal-time row counts only; no feature, label, return, or score used
split.early_stop_rule: early_stop_start <= signal_time < calibration_start and interval_end < calibration_start
split.cross_segment_event_group_rule: purge the complete event_group_id from every segment

walkforward.inner_split: within prior data, first 70% train, next 15% early-stop, last 15% calibration by time; interval/event purge at both boundaries
walkforward.outer_test_rule: all event groups whose full label interval is inside the outer test window

model.early_stop_metric: early-stop segment exact top-decile mean net_ret_swap_taker; maximize; no cost is deducted again
model.single_feature_baseline: ordinary least-squares regression on ma_spread_pct only

selector.threshold_rule: q90 boundary midpoint when separable; otherwise the full equality block passes
selector.tie_policy: never slice equal scores by row order, candidate id, or outcome
selector.exact_top_decile: report separately; if the boundary is tied, mark exact-k result unavailable rather than slice
selector.fixed_gate: calibrate once on calibration segment, then apply the same numeric threshold and >= operator

economics.primary_statistic: fixed-gate mean selected net return after approved pressure cost
economics.matched_control: one-to-one without replacement from nonselected P1 candidates; same symbol x UTC week x fold-local atr_pct quintile; exclude shared event_group_id; deterministic seed 42
economics.matched_lift: selected mean pressure-net minus matched-control mean pressure-net
economics.block_permutation: one-sided exact sign-flip of matched-pair lift by UTC week block; statistic is economic lift, never AUC

actual_cost_pressure_line.recommended: total round-trip 0.0015: P1 net_ret_swap_taker minus fixed 0.0005 slippage; funding not modeled because P1-only scope contains no funding
actual_cost_pressure_line.evidence: P1 includes 0.001 taker only; historical clean fill pairs for measured slippage = 0

fixed_runtime_gate.recommended: calibration q90; >=; midpoint if separable; whole tie block otherwise; pass 8%-12%; equal rate <=2%; no tie slicing

owner_approval.context: approval of the two concrete recommended values in the immediately preceding assistant message
